title: Reconstruct Transcendence as exact HC base plus overlay
claim: The current Transcendence frontier is largely an exact byte subset of HC-Brain plus an explicit Transcendence overlay. A pinned HC tree plus adds/overwrites/deletions is being tested for exact Git-tree reconstruction; no moving-base inheritance or dependency adoption is implied.

consumers.role: pinned candidate base bytes only; no downstream semantic authority
exact target and independently owned research overlay

preserved_boundaries: Transcendence-specific BCI, continuity, human-state archive, privacy, threat-model, and experimental material remains independently owned.
No duplicated file is removed and no repository dependency is created by the experiment.
The HC base is an exact pinned byte subject, not a moving branch or semantic authority.
HC-only paths are explicit deletions; later HC cognitive/runtime features do not silently enter Transcendence.
promotion_evidence: Stable main↔main comparison: 255 of 263 Transcendence files are identical at the same paths, accounting for 1,718,257 of 1,802,005 target bytes (95.352510121%).
Current HC PR #22 ↔ Transcendence PR #7 comparison: 254 of 288 Transcendence files are identical at the same paths, accounting for 1,706,224 of 1,992,586 target bytes (85.628625314%).
Current exact overlay payload is 34 files / 286,362 bytes (14.371374686% of target bytes), plus 39 explicit deletions.
Complete path/mode/blob snapshots and an executable recursive Git-tree reconstruction validator are staged in this exact Discovery successor.
rejection_conditions: The exact HC base plus overlay fails to reconstruct target tree 112a44d8042556b87f19b3dac05ec34a5ea2f796.
A base-upgrade simulation shows that preserving Transcendence semantics requires importing excluded HC features or large recurring conflict repair.
The dependency materially increases failure, migration, or qualification risk.
Transcendence must independently modify a large fraction of currently shared HC bytes often enough that the pinned-base model creates more maintenance than it removes.

critical_objections: High byte overlap does not prove a shared dependency is operationally cheaper; upgrade/rebase burden is still unmeasured.
The 39-file deletion set shows real intentional divergence and makes moving-base inheritance unsafe.
Nine same-path overrides include reference-kernel implementation/tests, so some copied base behavior is intentionally modified rather than passive duplication.
Exact reconstruction proves source factorization only. It grants HC no authority over Transcendence semantics and does not authorize repository rewrites.

notes: Current source experiment binds HC PR #22 exact head 5929da3e8904e23e484df0deac920a008ec33d52 and Transcendence PR #7 exact head be3785c83dbe89b0d4236b43eda97a277eb6baad.
Exact reconstruction must pass before any base-plus-overlay claim is promoted beyond EXPERIMENTING.
After reconstruction, the next falsifier is a later-HC-base upgrade simulation; do not adopt a dependency merely from overlap.
